race.comment: WAR TRAIL (2) has the most reliable recent profile, returning from a two-month let-up after a Northam fourth when beaten a length and a half and making ground despite covering ground. His earlier long-neck second at this track reads well for a Mdn of this standard, and he is still lightly raced enough to have more to offer. KAZZAMATAZZ (8) is the immediate danger after being beaten only a neck at Northam over 1000m, with the step to 1200m the main qualification given she is yet to place at the distance. BEYOND A DOUBT (6) was costly as an odds-on chance at Albany but kept picking up after a slow start, and first-time blinkers plus William Pike give him a clear rebound angle. MYSTIC EMPRESS (7) was plain last start at Northam, yet her prior fifth at this track had more finish in it and barrier 1 gives her a platform to turn that into a place result. JARVO (4) creates some interest on debut.
